plan.title: Create RFQ from Open Service PR

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is possible.
Assert that the imported PR product, variant, and requested quantity are read-only on the pricing sheet.
Verify the imported PR quantity is shown on the create screen.
Verify the imported PR unit is shown on the create screen.
Provide the mandatory event title required before publishing.
Add the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the completed PR-based RFQ event.
Assert that publishing reached a real project page.
Return to the event created by this plan for post-publish menu verification.
Assert that Recreate Order is greyed out for this PR-created event.
